children.name: Pneumatology is a major branch of Christian theology that examines:
The nature and person of the Holy Spirit - Understanding the Spirit as the third person of the Trinity
The Spirit's role in salvation - Including conviction of sin, regeneration, and sanctification
Spiritual gifts and manifestations - Such as prophecy, tongues, healing, and other charisms
The Spirit's work in believers - Including guidance, empowerment, and spiritual formation
The Spirit's role in Scripture - Inspiration and illumination of biblical texts
The Spirit in the church - Corporate worship, unity, and mission
